$description: BIM BUILDING GRID token category — structural module dimensions, wall/partition thicknesses, and the floor-plate-width tolerance bands that drive the Building Width Calculator's bidirectional adjustment logic. Source: internal design documentation. Metre values are authoritative; feet equivalents in $description.

grid.$description: Structural module and wall/partition thickness constants used when converting centerline Habitat+Magazine+Corridor arithmetic into an overall building width.

structural-module.$description: 5'0" — the base structural grid module. This is also the unit of bidirectional adjustment: the Building Width Calculator's tolerance bands (below) are expressed as multiples of this module (green = 0.5×, yellow = 1×, red = 2×).

facade-wall-thickness.$description: 1'4" — exterior façade wall thickness, added to the Habitat+2+3 centerline sum to get overall building width.

demising-wall-thickness.$description: 6" — thickness of a demising wall between adjacent tenant leaseholds.

corridor-partition-thickness.$description: 4¾" — thickness of a corridor-side partition wall.

tolerance.$description: Floor-plate-width tolerance bands for the Building Width Calculator's bidirectional adjustment logic. Habitat and Corridor are locked downward by regulatory minima (EN 12464-1, IBC/NBC egress); Magazine is the only zone with no hard regulatory floor and yields first when a floor plate must be resized.

fp-width-green-band.$description: ±2.5 ft (0.5× the structural module). Within this band, Magazine absorbs the delta silently — no composition change, no operator review required.

fp-width-yellow-band.$description: ±5 ft (1× the structural module). Magazine adjusts, key-plan areas are recomputed, tile lengths snap to the new width — operator review required before committing the adjustment.

fp-width-red-band.$description: ±10 ft (2× the structural module). Beyond this band the tile family itself changes (Small→Medium or Medium→Large) — door count and climate-zone count shift, and tenant demising is affected. Requires a full re-composition, not just a zone adjustment.

demising-structural.$description: 2'0" — the gap between our source documentation's stated total width (21m) and the arithmetic sum of the Professional Office zone depths (2×(6.0+3.8)+2.0 = 21.6m). This 0.6m is structural/demising allowance not captured as a separate line item in the headline total — the detailed arithmetic is correct; the headline total is the rounded/summary figure.
